text: Bahrain's Economic Development Board (EDB) is the Bahraini government's investment promotion agency, chaired by the Crown Prince of Bahrain.
short: Bahrain EDB is a Bahraini government agency chaired by the Crown Prince

source.name: Bahrain EDB — Frequently asked questions (archived)
source.quote: The EDB is an investment promotion agency, chaired by His Royal Highness the Crown Prince of Bahrain, with the overall responsibility for attracting investment into Bahrain

additionalSources.name: Fortune — Amid the Gulf's increasingly competitive landscape, Bahrain is carving out a distinct investment strategy (Melissa Hancock)
additionalSources.quote: according to the head of the government agency tasked with bringing investment into the kingdom
